community.label: Community
community.support_title: Support the Dev — we're students too
community.support_short: Built Talibroom while studying GI. Servers aren't free — if we helped you find your crib, consider a coffee. ❤️
community.support_long: Hey fam. We built Talibroom because we know exactly how much of a nightmare it is to find a decent roommate or apartment as a student. We literally coded this whole platform while studying Génie Informatique just to fix this broken system for all of us. We are keeping the core app 100% free, but servers cost money. If Talibroom helped you secure your crib, consider dropping a small donation to keep the servers running so we can pass the vibe check for the next generation of students. ❤️
community.support_thanks: Any amount helps. Thank you fr. 🙏
